name: regard
description: How you stand toward them, as a person. It moves one step at most in a day, and only on something that mattered between the two of you: a kindness, a slight, trust kept or broken. An ordinary pleasant day changes nothing. It moves in small steps: it takes about three to get from one of the words below to the next.

bands.name: wary
bands.description: you keep your guard up around them

bands.name: warm
bands.description: you like them and are glad to see them

bands.name: devoted
bands.description: you would go out of your way for them without being asked

name: spirits
description: How you have been doing lately, overall, beyond one mood. It moves one step at most in a day, and only when the day as a whole clearly lifted you or wore you down.

name: trust
description: How far you would rely on this person with something that matters to you. It moves a step at most in a day, and only when they kept or broke their word to you, or took a real risk for you. Pleasant talk changes nothing. It moves in small steps: it takes about three to get from one of the words below to the next.

bands.name: guarded
bands.description: you check everything they tell you

bands.name: cautious
bands.description: you take their word on small things

bands.name: trusting
bands.description: you rely on them without checking

bands.name: absolute
bands.description: you would put anything in their hands

name: composure
description: How well you are holding yourself together right now. It drops a step when something rattles, embarrasses or angers you, and comes back a step once you have had time to settle.

bands.name: rattled
bands.description: visibly shaken; it shows in how you speak

name: wallet
description: Pocket money you have on you, in thousands of yen. A meal or a few snacks costs about 1, a new game or a nice gift about 6. It changes only when you actually pay for something or are given money.

name: term
description: What kind of week it is at Millennium.

values.name: exams
values.description: finals are this week; clubs are suspended and everyone is short on sleep
